description: A project dedicated to exploring the Moon and Mars in search of lost objects, using technology, innovation, and space exploration.
summary: COSMIC FOOTPRINTS is an interactive game created by our team, AstroHacks, to make learning about NASA’s space missions more exciting. Players can explore nine locations on the Moon and Mars, discover objects left behind by past missions, and learn about their purpose and importance. We included animated 3D environments, interactive models, a scanner, missions, quizzes, rewards, and rover companions with unique personalities to make the experience feel like a real adventure. We developed the project using Google AI Studio, combining AI-assisted coding, 3D modeling, animations, and interactive simulations. Our goal is to make space exploration easier and more fun to understand, especially for younger audiences, while inspiring curiosity about science and technology. We want players to realize that exploring space is not only about reaching new worlds, but also about understanding the history and discoveries we leave behind.
details: COSMIC FOOTPRINTS is an interactive educational game created by our team, AstroHacks, to bring the history of NASA’s space missions to life. Players can explore nine locations on the Moon and Mars, discover objects left behind by past missions, and learn about their purpose, history, and scientific importance. To make the experience more engaging, we included animated 3D environments, interactive models, a scanner, missions, quizzes, rewards, and rover companions with different personalities. We developed the project using Google AI Studio, combining AI-assisted coding, 3D modeling, animations, and interactive simulations. Our goal is to make learning about space more fun and accessible, especially for younger audiences, while encouraging curiosity about science and technology. We believe that exploring space is not just about reaching new worlds, but also about understanding and remembering what we leave behind.
